build_xm_transformer_model: build an XMTransformerModel for multilingual speech-to-text using wav2vec encoder and transformer decoder
build_conv1d_adaptor: build a Conv1dAdaptor module with configurable layers, kernel size, stride, and layerdrop for feature adaptation
build_wav2vec_encoder_with_adaptor: build a Wav2VecEncoderWithAdaptor that wraps a wav2vec encoder with an optional convolutional adaptor
load_pretrained_xm_transformer: load a pretrained XMTransformerModel from a checkpoint file or hub model ID for inference
configure_xm_transformer_architecture: configure the base XMTransformer architecture with default wav2vec, adaptor, and decoder arguments
